name: After recital R
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text: Ra. whereas over 150 foreign nationals with pro-Russian leanings were given shooting training in Serbia with the intention of inciting unrest ahead of Moldova’s 2025 parliamentary elections; whereas perpetrators of this crime, one of whom was linked to a high-ranking Serbian official, were only arrested after a media outcry; whereas the Serbian Government exerted direct pressure on the 2025 parliamentary elections in Kosovo;
